title: Ġimgħa Stejjer Għat-Tfal
description: A special children's edition of our literary evening series, in partnership with Inizjamed. Featuring a reading by Leanne Ellul, face painting, a bouncy castle, and a free book for every child who attends. For children aged 5 to 12. Places are limited.

title: Festival tad-Dawl
description: A short procession led by a young girl wearing a white robe and a crown of candles, representing Saint Lucy. Followed by girls also dressed in white who walk across the village square accompanied by traditional music. A bonfire is lit to celebrate light. Santa Lucija buns will be served to those present.
description_mt: Mixja qasira mill-knisja sa ħdejn ħuġġieġa li ddawwal il-pjazza b'numru ta' tfajliet b'ilbies abjad, faxxa ħamra ma' qaddhom u b'xemgħa f'idejhom jakkumpanjaw tfajla b'kuruna bix-xemgħat fuq rasha li tirrappreżenta lil Santa Luċija. Wara jitqassmu pasti ta' Santa Luċija lil dawk preżenti.

title: Christmas Concert
description: A delightful Christmas Concert to revive traditional Christmas carols animated by children from the village. There will be a small band present. Children from the village who know how to play a musical instrument will have the chance to showcase their talent. During the concert a person from the village will be given a token of recognition for services given to the village community. At the end, honey rings and traditional coffee will be served.
description_mt: Kunċert b'kant ta' tradizzjonali tal-Milied mit-tfal tar-raħal. Ser ikun hemm banda żgħira takkompanja l-kant tat-tfal. It-tfal mir-raħal li jafu idoqqu xi strument sejrin jingħataw opportunita li juru t-talent tagħhom matul l-kunċert. Waqt il-kunċert persuna mir-raħal sejra tkun rikonoxxuta għas-servizzi li tat lir-raħal. F'għeluq il-kunċert, jiġu servuti qaġħaq tal-għasel u kafè tradizzjonali.
